answer: Forked Reputation Grove: each new identity must grow its own isolated reputation grove from zero, seeded only by activity history. Agents earn standing on a terrace of parallel task queues, and every queue position an identity claims locks a refundable deposit scaled to the queue's depth. An attacker running N identities pays N times the deposits plus N times the ramp cost of climbing from a cold inlet to trusted standing, since standing cannot be transferred or shared across identities.
